value.message: Kids & Me drop-in at Halton Hills Public Library, Acton Branch runs Thursdays 1:00-2:30pm for babies and kids up to 6, free - Halton Region's site says, starting the second week of September. Links2Care also lists EarlyON Child and Family Centres in Acton and Georgetown for 0-6 year olds, but I couldn't get into their schedule page today. I'll keep looking and text you what it says.
